property_name: Hudson Valley Plaza - Lowe's and Sam's Club Buildings
note: Divestment of the Lowe's and Sam's Club buildings within Hudson Valley Plaza, New York, completed 14 August 2024. Consideration US$36.5m = 4.3% premium over independent valuation US$35.0m (as at 30 Jun 2024) and 17.5% premium over original purchase price US$31.1m (p35). Net cash received from divestment US$35.2m (p32; cash-flow 'Divestment of investment properties and related assets and liabilities' US$35,176k). Only completed investment-property divestment in FY2024, so the Statement-of-Total-Return 'Gain on divestment of investment properties' US$2,156k is attributable to this deal. Buyer not named. Remainder of Hudson Valley Plaza retained (FY2024 carrying value US$27,900k).
gain_on_divestment_basis: disclosed_premium_vs_valuation 4.3% and vs_original_cost 17.5%: sale US$36.5m vs valuation US$35.0m (4.3% premium) and vs purchase price US$31.1m (17.5% premium). Disclosed figures taken verbatim (p35), not derived.

note: Classified as investment property held for divestment at 31 Dec 2024 (carrying value = fair value US$23,800k, independent valuation by CBRE, Inc.). Divestment completed 17 January 2025 (subsequent event) for a consideration of US$23.8m = 4.2% above the original purchase price of US$22.9m (p34). Buyer not named. Recorded here under FY2024 as the asset was held-for-divestment at year-end; the resulting (Loss)/gain is recognised in FY2025.
carrying_value_basis: Balance-sheet 'Investment property held for divestment' line US$23,800k at 31 Dec 2024 (p141 SFP; p150 Portfolio Statement fn(2)); = fair value = subsequent Jan-2025 sale consideration.
gain_on_divestment_basis: disclosed_premium_vs_original_purchase_price 4.2%: sale US$23.8m vs purchase price US$22.9m (p34). Disclosed figure, not derived. Note the accounting (Loss)/gain vs carrying value falls in FY2025.
